remarks:
This is an excellent hunting and recreational property consisting of an off-grid cabin and woodlands on 11.98 acres in Cuba NY, Allegany County.

The land is predominantly wooded with a mix of hardwoods including red oak and shagbark hickory. Acorns and hickory nuts provide a natural food source for wildlife, and deer sign is evident throughout the acreage. The mix of mature timber, understory, and varied terrain creates excellent conditions for whitetail and turkey hunting.

The cabin has been updated inside and out and provides a comfortable place to stay during hunting season or weekend trips. Knotty pine walls and ceilings give the interior a classic camp feel, while several vinyl windows bring in plenty of natural light. The open floor plan has space for sleeping, storage, and a small kitchenette. The bed, dresser, table, and a portable generator convey with the sale.

An open area surrounding the cabin provides parking and usable outdoor space. A separate storage shed and a tarped metal-frame shelter offer room for tools, equipment, and the newer Husqvarna riding mower, which also conveys.

You get the privacy of nearly 12 wooded acres while remaining just minutes from downtown Cuba and a short drive from Cuba Lake and the Cuba Lake Casino. Surface rights convey.
